title: lindsaea pumila
intro: Lindsaea pumila, commonly known as the dwarf tree fern, is a small, terrestrial fern species belonging to the family Lindsaeaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Lindsaea pumila are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in its leaves and roots.
